context: A uni student catches up with a teen friend after class
purpose: Teach: もっぱら/それなのに/いやぁ/おもっ/しょっちゅう/時折/一口/出番

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いやぁ、久しぶり。最近しょっちゅう図書館にこもってて、サクラに会う時間なかったわ。
lines.en: Hey, long time. I've been holed up in the library so often I haven't had time to see you.
lines.style: Warm casual reunion tone, slightly tired but genuinely happy to reconnect with a younger friend.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ほんとだよ〜。前はもっぱら部活帰りに寄ってくれてたのにさ。
lines.en: Right? You used to drop by mostly on your way home from club activities.
lines.style: Playfully pouting teen voice, half-complaining but affectionate toward an older friend.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ごめんって。今期はレポート地獄で、時折ふっと高校時代をおもっちゃうよ。
lines.en: Sorry, sorry. This term's report hell, and now and then I find myself thinking back to high school.
lines.style: Apologetic and a touch nostalgic, the voice of someone overworked but reflective.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ふふ、先輩がそんなこと言うなんて意外。はい、これ一口あげる、新作のチョコ。
lines.en: Hehe, surprising to hear you say that, senpai. Here, have a bite, it's the new chocolate.
lines.style: Cheerful teasing teen energy, offering a treat with bright friendly sweetness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お、サンキュー。…うま。それなのにお前、自分は二口食べてるじゃん。
lines.en: Oh, thanks. ...Tasty. And yet you're taking two bites yourself, huh.
lines.style: Mock-accusatory and amused, easy banter between close friends across age gap.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: バレた?ところでさ、今度の文化祭、軽音の出番が私のクラスの直後なんだって。来てよ!
lines.en: Caught me! By the way, at the next school festival the light music club's slot is right after my class. Come watch!
lines.style: Excited teen pitch shifting into eager invitation, bouncy and inviting.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: マジか、行く行く。最近の高校生のバンド、レベル高いってよく聞くし楽しみ。
lines.en: Seriously? I'll come for sure. I keep hearing high schoolers' bands are really good these days, looking forward to it.
lines.style: Genuine enthusiasm from a supportive older friend, upbeat and committed.
